g.text: Crafty — prompt turn ownership and recovery
Protocol permission is separate from design approval.
Ordinary photo/measurement forms are durable interactions;
their MCP request returns without waiting for a browser.
Cancel is a notification, not a request/response pair.
Request cancellation of associated CAD jobs separately.
Accept final updates but fence domain publication.
Never silently resend a prompt after an ambiguous send.
Runtime epoch rejects events from replaced processes.
Persist user messages independently of agent echoes.
Browser disconnect only detaches a subscriber; work continues.
API replay uses durable sequence numbers, not timer-based "settling".
Session load replay is reconciled separately from live events.
Optional queued user messages are dispatched serially after a terminal turn.
validated response on original request ID
fence old epoch; stop orphan jobs
